notes: Training week is required (2026: June 22 to 26). The page lists both 12 shifts over six weeks and at least 10 shifts across five weeks, so ask which applies. Closing date for 2027 not posted. Students do not work directly with animals except at the Living Seashore exhibit.
name: Youth Exhibit Guide Program
what_you_do: Spend a summer as a volunteer guide in the Aquarium galleries after a week of training. Talk with guests and learn about marine science careers.
who_can_apply: Local high school students who finished 9th grade, are interested in marine biology or environmental science, and can do the full program including the training week and the shifts.
pay_detail: Unpaid. $40 fee for registration and materials if accepted (need-based scholarships are available).
duration: About 6 weeks of volunteering after a training week (2026: June 29 to Aug 9)
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in December 2026 (exact day not posted). 2026 interviews were held in late February and early March.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it opens in December. Selected students come to an in-person interview with Aquarium volunteer staff.
